evidence: app/package.json:18-19 — pins @builder.io/qwik and qwik-city 1.20.3, the current stable line (2026-10-25); avoids the v2 RC (@qwik.dev/*)
app/vite.config.ts:8-13 — plain qwikVite/qwikCity plugins, no experimental flags or opt-ins
app/src/routes/index.tsx:1,78 — useTask$ (stable since 1.6, late 2024), the newest core API used in the app
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:274 — DocumentHead with resolveValue, the long-documented v1 head pattern
reach.rationale: Only long-stable APIs from the current 1.x stable line; no experimental, preview or RC surface at all. The single recently-stable API is starter boilerplate, not a feature bet.

evidence: app/src/entry.node-server.tsx:28-40 — the one recently-stable API (getRequestEvent for crash diagnostics) lives in the server entry, one file, trivially removable
app/adapters/node-server/vite.config.ts:14 — ssg disabled via the documented adapter option, no experimental build flags anywhere
containment.rationale: Nothing experimental to contain; the only recent API is isolated in the entry point exactly as the official template ships it.

evidence: app/src/entry.node-server.tsx:22-44 — getRequestEvent/monitor handler is verbatim current starter boilerplate for diagnostics, not a novelty pick
app/src/lib/server-api.ts:36-51 — data fetching is plain fetch + in-memory TTL cache, no experimental caching/streaming APIs
justification.rationale: No experimental usage means no unjustified risk; every API chosen is the documented stable path for the requirement it serves.

findings.issue: Exact pin to 1.20.3 is current stable but Qwik 2.0 RC is already shipping with package renames (@qwik.dev/*) and breaking route-loader changes; a future 2.x migration will touch these files.
findings.suggestion: Nothing to change now; keep an upgrade note so the eventual v2 rename/breaking changes are planned rather than discovered.

summary: The app is deliberately conservative: 100% stable Qwik/Qwik City 1.x APIs on the exact current stable release, with zero experimental, preview or RC usage. The only recently-stable API is verbatim starter-template diagnostics in the server entry. Experimentalness risk is effectively nil, at the mild cost of a pending (but well-signposted) v2 migration.
